verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official CLI for managing agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases and other resources from the terminal, and a probe confirms a dedicated CLI docs page exists. The evidence is limited to summary-level descriptions. missing for 10: detailed command reference or install specifics, documented AI-native/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
The Retell CLI lets you manage Retell resources from your terminal.
